thread:
Sophia: Heads-up — PR #9921 is ready but I'm holding on a design blessing before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9921 RFC: https://rfc.redwood.ai/r/serve-routing-v2 — main ask: confirm fallback semantics and rollout config. can someone from arch take a pass? cc @Maria

David: quick q — does this change the default routing policy for sandbox/low-tier customers or just enterprise routes?

Sophia: it will change the default for sandbox to prefer the cheap-variant when latency budgets allow; enterprise routes unchanged. Canary plan attached: 
```
canary: 10% region-us-east for 4h
monitor: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, kv-cache-hit
fallback: cheap-variant -> full-model
```

Shiv: need the perf run numbers and SLO delta to sign off on safety. can you paste the perf summary? :eyes:

Sophia: Perf summary (internal): p95 85ms -> 92ms on sparc-2 with caching enabled; token cost down ~7%. Modeled SLO risk: <1% chance of exceeding p95 SLA during canary window. Full graphs in RFC link above.

Maria: I can review tonight and aim to leave a short design note by 09:00 UTC. please make sure failure-mode is explicit in deploy config (what happens if fallback fails). :+1:

infra-bot: automated-check: PR 9921 missing 'canary-rollback' field in deploy config. See CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/9921

Sophia: thanks infra-bot — pushed patch to add `canary_rollback` and a short failure-mode docstring.

Maria: reading it now. left one comment about explicit region routing and a suggestion to surface kv-cache hit-rate as an alert threshold. otherwise looks good. if we keep canary at 10% and watch cache hit-rate, i can give architecture blessing.

Sophia: noted — I'll add the alert and pin canary to 10%. planning to merge in the 10:00 PDT release slot if no further blockers.

Maria: arch-bless: ✅ added a short note to the RFC thread at https://rfc.redwood.ai/r/serve-routing-v2#note-arch-9921 — please record post-canary observations in the RFC comments.

Sophia: merging after canary completes and monitoring passes. will follow up here with results. thanks all! :tada:
